name: Captain Jonathan Archer — "When Captain Archer enters" is the card itself; "The" is never a short name
notes: 2026-11-25. The self-reference swap knew the full name, the part before a comma and the first word, so "Captain" alone was replaced and the trigger read "When this card Archer enters". A name of three or more words is now also shortened to its first and last word. The first word alone is never "The": The Wandering Minstrel read "This card Minstrel's Ballad" for its ability word.

$includes: When this card enters, create Porthos, a legendary 1/1 green Dog creature token.
The Minstrel's Ballad — At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control five or more Towns, create a 2/2 Elemental creature token that's all colors.
